books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.line: Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do.
books.passage: Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, "and what is the use of a book," thought Alice, "without pictures or conversations?"
